description: This source file contains unit tests for the GatewayAutostartPolicy logic in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing conditions for starting a gateway and ensuring launch agents based on different modes and paused states.

classes.name: GatewayAutostartPolicyTests
classes.description: A test suite structured to verify the behavior of GatewayAutostartPolicy related to gateway startup and launch agent conditions.

methods.name: starts gateway only when local and not paused
methods.description: Tests that the gateway starts only in local mode when not paused, and does not start when paused or in other modes.

methods.name: ensures launch agent when local and not attach only
methods.description: Tests that a launch agent is ensured only in local mode when not paused, and not in remote or paused conditions.
